caption: The drawing features a single, three-dimensional figure of a person rendered in shades of gray, creating a sense of texture and volume. The person is standing upright, facing slightly to the left, with legs apart and is dressed in a long coat and a rounded hat. The person's facial features are minimal, and the eyes are closed or suggested with simple lines. Both arms are bent at the elbows, holding an elongated cylindrical object (possibly a flute or stick) vertically in front of the face. The coat is detailed with buttons down the front, and the texture is shaded to suggest fabric or surface pattern. In the upper left corner of the drawing is an inset outline sketch of the same figure, shown in a flat plain line view, with a two-inch scale bar beneath it for reference. The background is plain and uncolored, while the border of the drawing is defined by a faint rectangular line. The signature "J. Staloff" appears near the bottom right corner inside the border. The overall composition is monochromatic, focused on grayscale shading and outlines.
